Adobe Lightroom Apply Custom Edit Settings to an Image

items.docs: Applies custom Lightroom develop settings to an image. Accepts a comprehensive set of editing parameters covering white balance, exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, tone curve, HSL, split toning, sharpening, noise reduction, lens corrections, and more. Provides the full range of non-destructive editing capabilities available in the Lightroom develop module.
